title: Rotate Matrix by 90 degrees
stepTitle: Solve Problems on Arrays [Easy -> Medium -> Hard]
category: Solve Problems on Arrays [Easy -> Medium -> Hard]
problemStatement: Rotate an n x n matrix by 90 degrees clockwise, in-place.
intuition: Clockwise rotation = transpose (mirror over the main diagonal) followed by reversing each row. Both steps are trivially in-place.

approaches.title: Brute: copy into a new matrix
Optimal: transpose then reverse rows
approaches.idea: Swap only the upper triangle, then reverse each row.
approaches.whyWorks: Transpose maps (i,j)->(j,i); reversing rows then maps j -> n-1-j, composing to the rotation.

edgeCases: Even vs odd n (loop bounds are the same)
commonMistakes: Transposing the full matrix (j from 0), which undoes the swap
patternRecognition: Geometric transforms decompose into transpose + reflection
followUps: Rotate a rectangular matrix (needs new storage)
interviewInsight: Deriving the composition on paper beats memorising; they often ask for anticlockwise on the spot.
